method: NAIVE and AS PUBLISHED. Written in one pass from HDB's web pages as read on 12 October 2026, in the style of the writing-l4-rules skill. The source is administrative policy, not law. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: HDB web pages 'Couples and Families' (Fiance and fiancee tab), 'Singles' (Singles tab), 'Enhanced CPF Housing Grant for Singles' with its linked PDF table of EHG amounts, and 'Conditions After Buying a New Flat', all as read on 12 October 2026. Figures are as published on that date; the only page-given effective date is the EHG (Singles) 'From 20 August 2024'.
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the source pages are Singapore Government copyright and are not reproduced -- see ../../SOURCE-LICENSE.md

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read (runcases.py: written=41 satisfied=41 errors=0).

scope: SCOPED to a new flat bought from HDB. The Fiance/Fiancee Scheme (flat types up to 5-room, citizenship, age 21, the income ceilings by flat type, the private and non-residential property conditions and the 30-month wait, the two-subsidy bar, solemnisation within 3 months of completion); the Single Singapore Citizen Scheme for a new 2-room Flexi flat (citizen, single, age 35, $8,000 ceiling, first-timer, the property conditions, the $15,000 additional amount); the Enhanced CPF Housing Grant (Singles) for a single alone and for two or more singles (eligibility and the two published tables, from 20 August 2024); the minimum occupation period by classification (Standard or unclassified 5 years, Plus and Prime 10, Fresh Start 20) and the first day of open-market sale. Not encoded: resale flats and resale grants, multi-generation, orphaned-sibling, non-resident-family and seniors routes, SPR households, the extended-family ceiling, the EHG table for a non-resident spouse, EHG pro-rating, MOP exclusions, the resale levy and subsidy recovery. Added for REQ-0007, REQ-0018 and REQ-0274.
